goal: Make GitHub Pages the canonical public observability surface for the open-source project without exposing secrets, credentials, private data, or unsafe operational controls.
source_of_truth: Repository-controlled generated manifests and verified CI artifacts; Pages must not invent status values.
evidence_policy: Every displayed status must have a repository source, generated artifact, CI result, test result, benchmark result, or explicit owner-recorded blocker. Unknown is preferable to an invented status.
inventory_policy: Inventory generators should scan repository files and tracked configuration, map each item to its owning subsystem where possible, and flag unmapped items for review. The dashboard must expose coverage totals and unmapped counts.
actions_policy: Pages should expose workflow health, latest verified runs, failures, artifacts, benchmark runs, and remediation status using safe summaries. It must not expose credentials or secret values.
download_policy: Every downloadable artifact must link to a verified GitHub Release artifact or repository-controlled build artifact. A download button must not claim an artifact exists until CI verifies it.
open_source_policy: Show source links, architecture, version history, changelog, benchmark methodology, limitations, and contribution paths. Clearly distinguish experimental, assisted, simulated, and production-ready claims.
no_false_claims: Do not display passing when a required check failed.
Do not display mastery without benchmark evidence.
Do not display production-ready when release/build gates are incomplete.
Do not display a download as verified until the artifact is actually available and integrity-checked.
update_strategy: Regenerate dashboard data from repository state and verified CI evidence; prefer incremental generation with deterministic output and cache unchanged sources.
performance: Parallelize independent inventory and metric collection, cache immutable inputs, and serialize conflicting generated-file writes.
fallback: If a data source is unavailable, display its last verified timestamp plus an explicit stale/unknown status instead of fabricating current data.
